segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Check out this two-in-one folding treadmill from Home Fitness Code.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: It's easy to assemble, you just need to screw two knobs to fix the handrail and you can use the treadmill.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: It has multi-speed and an LCD screen.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: You can speed up to 10 km an hour under running mode.
